scripts.build: npm run build -w @globe2/shared && npm run build -w @globe2/client && npm run build -w @globe2/server
scripts.check: npm run build -w @globe2/shared && npm run check -w @globe2/client && npm run check -w @globe2/server && npm run check -w @globe2/shared
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
